about_the_game:
You are Kebechet, Daughter of Anpu, The Custodian of Death.

Your sacred duty is to lay to rest all who serve Apep, the great serpent of oblivion, and any who defy the divine order by becoming Exanimus, making a mockery of life and death alike. Take up the role of Kebechet, the Purifier and defeat the hordes of Apep the Serpent of Chaos. Traverse through the many corrupted temples of the Neter and return Ma'at to the world. 

Gameplay Overview

Kebechet, Daughter of Anpu is a third-person action-adventure game built around fast, stylish combat and divine magic.

You wield:

  • A giant scythe as your primary weapon

  • A suite of ancient spells powered by the Logia Arcana

  • The ability to accept missions from Anpu to hunt down corrupted beings who have outlived their mortal time

Many Exanimous creatures command followers and minions, all of whom stand equally guilty in the eyes of the divine.

Varied Spellcasting

Master a wide array of spells drawn from multiple schools of magic. Each discipline offers distinct effects, synergies, and tactical advantages, encouraging experimentation and mastery.

Enemy Stagger & Execution System

Well-timed attacks and spell effects can stagger enemies, leaving them vulnerable. Capitalize on these moments to unleash devastating execution attacks and end encounters decisively.

Tenipotence Mode

Unleash Tenipotence, a high-risk, high-reward power state designed for skilled players. This form dramatically boosts all of Kebechet’s stats at the cost of halved defenses, demanding precision, aggression, and confident decision-making.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for faster loading times
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Kebechet Daughter of Anubis is a third person roguelike action game. Master the art of Seal Sequence Spell casting as you battle corrupted hordes to cleanse the Exanimus and restore Ma'at to the world.
